description: Subscribe to an address. When it enters an issuer blacklist, a sanctions list or a scam database, we POST a signed event to your callback URL. A one-off check cannot warn you about a freeze that has not happened yet. Billed per address per day. The callback must be public https.

address.description: Blockchain address (TRON, Ethereum or other EVM, Solana)

callback_url.description: Public https URL to receive events

name: onyx_watch
title: Watch an address and get a webhook when it turns toxic
